patch.value: Address the PR #10 bot review: fixture-only main, shared git runner, no external chmod

CodeRabbit round on PR #10: merge the duplicated aliased imports, return the fixture git runner, drop the chmod spawn, and stop the default-parameter test from registering a git worktree in the real repository.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finding 1 (test/self-host.test.ts): Merged the mid-file aliased imports (_execFileSync, _readFileSync, _writeFileSync, _join, mkdirSync) into the top-of-file import block, dropping every underscore-prefixed alias. Added execFileSync to a new node:child_process import and mkdirSync/readFileSync to the existing node:fs import. Rewrote all use sites to the plain names. Moved the 'Private-function coverage' comment from above the removed import block to above the Fixture interface, since it explains the fixture plumbing.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finding 2 (test/self-host.test.ts): Added git(args: string[]): string to the Fixture interface and returned the existing git closure from fixture(). Replaced every repeated execFileSync("git", ..., {cwd, encoding, env}) block (in the main --write, main --check mismatch, and readSourceFiles executable tests) with f.git([...]). The env overrides (NODE_V8_COVERAGE, GIT_PAGER, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT) now live in exactly one place: the fixture's git closure.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finding 3 (test/self-host.test.ts): Deleted the execFileSync('chmod', ['+x', ...]) spawn entirely. The gate depends only on git. Since readSourceFiles reads the executable bit from the filesystem (via readWorkingStat), and in the real gate the filesystem mode is set by git's worktree checkout, the test now runs f.git(['checkout', 'HEAD', '--', 'run.sh']) after commit so git restores the executable bit onto the working tree. The test still asserts the resulting mode is 100755.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finding 4 (scripts/self-host.ts, test/self-host.test.ts): Made main take root and args as required positional parameters (main(root: string, args: readonly string[])), deleting both ?? defaults. Moved the default resolution (resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..') and process.argv) into the direct-invocation call site at the bottom of scripts/self-host.ts, which now passes them through the same indexed-call trick: [(_root, _args) => {}, main][Number(isMainInvocation(...))](resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..'), process.argv). The placeholder accepts the same args as main so element 0 (invoked on test import) is a covered call. Rewrote all fixture-based main() call sites to positional form and deleted the 'main without options runs the real self-host check on the package' test, which registered a git worktree in the developer's real repository during npm test. Coverage stays at 100/100/100/100 with no c8/istanbul ignores.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Finding 5 (.agents/pm/tasks/pm-vcs-lapg.toon): Moved pm-vcs-lapg from status: open to status: in_progress via 'pm update pm-vcs-lapg --status in_progress --author pi-agent' so it matches its siblings pm-vcs-r7h2 and pm-vcs-sd7h (both in_progress). Its deliverable (the NODE_V8_COVERAGE override in test/helpers/sandbox.ts and test/preflight.test.ts) already ships in this PR.

patch.value: The review round is complete and merged. Four CodeRabbit findings were fixed - duplicated aliased imports merged, the fixture git runner shared across ten call sites, the external chmod spawn removed, and main's default parameters deleted so no test registers a worktree in the developer's own repository. Two Sourcery suggestions were already covered before the round. The final full review reported no additional actionable issue.
